    if v is None:

        return s if s else None
    return v

    return isinstance(k, str) and k.lower() in GENERIC_LABELS

    for rr in range(row - 1, 0, -1):
        v = clean_key(sheet.cell(rr, col).value)
        if v is not None and not is_generic(v):
            return v, rr
    return None, None

def nearest_nonempty_left(sheet, row, col):
    for cc in range(col - 1, 0, -1):

            continue

        cat, _ = nearest_nonempty_above(ws, r, c)
        brand, _ = nearest_nonempty_left(ws, r, c)

        if brand in needed_brands and cat in needed_categories:
